This could technically be created as an AutoLoad addon, however it's such a common operation, that it would be nice to reuse it everywhere. In the case of addons, since they don't have a good dependency system, it would be kind of challenging to make this available to multiple addons.

As mentioned above, there's already prior art for such convenience functions on `SceneTree`.
answers.workaround: I think this would be used pretty often, especially for mobile games and addons that make a lot of HTTP calls to 3rd party services.
